leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize CSS custom properties in a JavaScript file to define dynamic styling variables.
Apply CSS custom properties to HTML elements using JavaScript to control visual presentation.
Manipulate CSS custom property values through JavaScript functions to update styles in real-time.
Integrate CSS custom properties with JavaScript event handlers to create interactive UI changes.
Construct a responsive color scheme by binding CSS custom properties to user input controls.
Configure CSS custom properties to dynamically adjust layout properties based on JavaScript logic.
Update CSS custom properties across multiple elements simultaneously using JavaScript loops or selectors.
